MOD POST --- make sure to read. There are some issues that have been going on in this subreddit that we need to address as a collective whole.

* **Users posting self-promotional links, websites, and referral codes.** That's made up a huge majority of our removal reasons in the past month.
* **Search the subreddit first before making a new post.** We've been seeing repeated posts from up to years ago likely for the purpose of karma farming. We remove as many posts as we can that suspect karma farming. We've had to remove a lot of the "girl getting arrested for SA" posts because they flood our feed.
* **Spreading false information or propaganda**, which can be dangerous.
* **Unnecessarily resorting to politics** or some other form of discrimination.

Do your best to continue to report spam or what looks like spam. Most of our post removals have been about staying polite (i.e, when people say "get a real job"), posting the same thing repeatedly, and going off topic (i.e., politics). Ooo. I like this MOD post!  🙏
Thanks folks.  Keep up the hard work.

Yet they spam their drivers with offers that lose money. Last time I opened the app, every single offer was extremely disrespectful

> No harassing people

Yet they spam their drivers with offers that lose money. 

> “We strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe”

Yet they spam their drivers with offers that lose money. This makes the app quite dangerous to use behind the wheel.

> “Doordash strives to promote a safe and positive experience”

The complete opposite of this is true.

> “Everyone who uses Doordash should act with honesty and integrity”

Doordash is one of the least honest, most unscrupulous corporations in the first world. Second only to Uber.

Dasher stole my food :/ Had an awful day at work, ordered some yummy tamales to cheer myself up. I waited about 45 minutes. Then the dasher decided to steal my food. The real kicker: it was 30 mins before closing so the restaurant refused to remake the order. It was a really great end to the day guys 😝 This is so frustrating. I ordered lunch for my son and I one day since I was working.. it was taking awhile and it cycled through 3 drivers. Just figured the restaurant was taking a while so they dipped. All of a sudden I get a message from the third driver and she asks if my order had already been delivered. I was confused as hell. I told her no, that it did say a guy was there waiting on the order about 30 mins prior, but that it had changed to her at some point after that. 

She tells me that the restaurant told her TWO OTHER drivers had come in to pick the up order before then and they wanted to make sure I didn’t get it before they made it for a third time. 

TWICE my order was stolen. 

She said they told her it was a guy that came in the first time and then a girl the second time. Likely a couple who did it together. She was soo upset for me and kept reassuring me she’d get me my order. She apologized like 5 times. Meanwhile I’m over here like “that’s annoying for the restaurant but no big deal for me.” 

I gave her an extra ten bucks in cash when she got here.
